HB 825, Election Improvements. Adams is listed among the co-sponsors (the primary sponsors are two other members). The filed bill would ban ranked choice voting, clarify election-related activity rules, shorten early voting, and change the acceptable forms of identification when a voter requests an absentee ballot, including a rule on photocopies of ID returned with the application and voted ballot. It was referred to the Rules committee on 4/9/2025.
